We’re looking for a Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps) to own the commercial operating system across the group's portfolio brands of Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr. You will lead the commercial operating plan, the shared CRM and data, attribution, forecasting, and the objective arbitration of capacity across commercial teams. This role reports to the CCO.

The Director of RevOps is the key connective role between leadership and the commercial team leads, translating strategy into an operating plan they run with, and turning their execution data into insight leadership can act on to drive predictable, efficient and sustainable revenue growth.

We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

In this role, please expect to travel up to 40% of the time.

**About Us

**Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.

Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.

The Role

As Director of RevOps, you will own the commercial revenue engine across all three brands, ensuring alignment between strategy, processes, technology and performance. You will build and lead a multidisciplinary team and act as a strategic partner to commercial leadership, driving operational excellence and turning insights into business outcomes.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Owning the commercial operating plan, revenue forecasting and pipeline performance across the portfolio, translating business objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Establish a shared CRM, account universe, campaign calendar and consistent funnel definitions, ensuring reliable data, clear processes and effective collaboration across brands.

• Driving data-led improvements in conversion, deal size, customer acquisition cost, customer lifetime value and return on investment. Lead reporting and performance reviews for the CCO, CEO and Finance.

• Providing an objective, data-driven perspective on commercial capacity and investment trade-offs, escalating key decisions to the CCO when needed.

• Owning the commercial technology stack, including HubSpot, BI, forecasting, marketing automation and AI, ensuring our tools and data enable scalable growth.

• Leading BI, marketing automation, customer and partner enablement, and product marketing. Partner with Product on feature prioritisation, pricing and packaging to strengthen go-to-market effectiveness.

**About You

**You are an experienced B2B SaaS RevOps leader who understands how to build a scalable, data-driven revenue engine. You combine strong commercial and financial acumen with analytical rigour and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance.

You thrive in complex environments where you can bring structure, align competing priorities and turn data into better commercial decisions.

You bring:

• Significant experience leading Revenue Operations or owning the Sales and Marketing revenue engine in a B2B SaaS business.

• Strong commercial and financial understanding, including ARR, NRR, churn, CAC, customer lifetime value and payback.

• Deep expertise in pipeline management, funnel design, forecasting, attribution and performance optimisation.

• Advanced HubSpot expertise, including architecture, governance and process design.

• Experience with BI, marketing automation, AI and revenue technology.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary, hybrid-working teams and driving change across functions without relying solely on formal authority.

• Strong executive communication skills and the ability to influence C-level decision-making.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience managing multi-brand or multi-product go-to-market operations on shared infrastructure.

• Experience with partner and channel models or account-based marketing.

• Familiarity with forecasting, conversation intelligence and advanced BI tools.

• Background in privacy, MarTech or analytics.

• Experience in a scale-up or PE- or VC-backed business.

• Fluency in German, French or a Nordic language.

What we offer

• Real ownership: Lead the commercial operating model across a three-brand portfolio.

• You’ll work closely with the CCO, CEO and commercial leadership to shape business priorities and decisions.

• You get to build shared systems, processes and insights that enable more effective and scalable commercial execution.

• A chance to make an impact: Strengthen how three growing SaaS brands plan, execute and scale their commercial growth through better data, processes and insights.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team

• Interview with a key stakeholder including a live case

• A final interview with our CCO

This process is subject to change. All applicants who progress to the screening call will be informed of the full process as some stages may be combined and/or in person.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

_We are looking for an experienced specialist to help lead our programmatic offering out of Aarhus. If you want to combine deep media expertise with client strategy and a commercial outlook, while honing your leadership skills, this could be your next step!

**Driving client strategy, commercial activities and a team of specialists

**As a Director in our programmatic team, you will take ownership of media planning and strategy on some of our largest clients. You will actively drive the commercial growth of our department while shaping our programmatic offering. Joining a collaborative team of 10 specialists, you will also expand your leadership skills by taking on the day-to-day management of a couple of our specialists in Aarhus.

You can look forward to:

• Commercial growth: Contributing to the continuous development of s360’s programmatic offering, as well as actively driving commercial projects and pitches from a programmatic and media strategy perspective.

**Join our programmatic team

**You’ll be joining a dynamic team of motivated specialists working across markets, platforms and media channels. We are a team of 10 across Aarhus and Copenhagen, working closely together, continuously pushing the boundaries of our offering. We are a tight knit team and we are regularly doing social events, both as a whole team across offices and as teams in each of the two locations.

**Shape the role with your expertise

**We are looking for a professional who can combine a deep specialist knowledge with an urge to drive cutting edge media strategy with a consultative mindset. You are ready to lead client relationships, drive complex engagements, and play an active role in strengthening our team and commercial offering.

To the role you will bring:

• Programmatic experience: You bring approximately 5 years of solid experience working with programmatic advertising spanning media planning, ad ops, execution in various ad-tech platforms (GMP experience preferred) and commercial pitching.

• Cross-channel and -media: You have experience across different platforms and channels within digital advertising. Experience with traditional offline media is considered a plus.

• Client management: You have experience in a client-facing role and recognise the absolute importance of cultivating strong, trusted client relations.

• Team mindset: You are a collaborative team player with high ambitions for both your personal development and the growth of the team around you.

**What It's Like Working At S360

**At s360, you will be part of a Marketing and AI consultancy, working alongside more than 330 skilled colleagues across 10 offices in 8 countries. While our shared mission is to help brands and retailers grow, we are equally committed to fostering a strong culture, defined by collaboration, drive, and continuous development. We believe that our culture and ways of working are key to delivering long-term, meaningful results.

As a part of our team, you can look forward to:

• Skilled colleagues: Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry and be part of an ambitious team with deep expertise across all key digital disciplines.

• Top-tier clients: Work with some of the biggest brands in the world on solving their most complex and interesting commercial problems.

• Growth journey: Join one of the fastest-growing marketing and AI consultancies in Europe with the ambition of becoming the best in the world.

• International environment: With 10 offices across 8 countries, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with people from diverse cultures around the world.

• Career acceleration: Get individual career plans to influence your own professional path and contribute to shaping the company’s future.

• Continuous development: A learning culture where people strive to become 1% better every day, supported by advanced training and knowledge sharing.

**We’d love to hear from you

**Does this sound like the right fit for you? Then don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Senior Director & Head of Mads Hantho at +45 30911567 or mhh@s360digital.com.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and hire as soon as the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are treated confidentially.

s360 is a marketing and AI consultancy. We help brands and retailers achieve measurable results with AI, proprietary technology, and over a decade of industry experience.

We're certified partners of Anthropic, Google, Meta, and Smartly, among others. As an end-to-end partner, we work with clients on strategy, execution, and forward deployment across brand, media, creative, and AI. Our specialists and engineers work from offices across Europe, close to the clients we serve.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Program Manager, Incubation Data Center (m/f/d), you will play a key role in driving innovation within the Data Center Business Unit at Danfoss Power Solutions, preferably based in Copenhagen, Denmark. You'll lead local and global cross-functional project teams from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, control and closure, ensuring successful delivery of the agreed business case. You'll take ownership of low- to medium-risk programs across new product development (NPD), product-related initiatives, large-scale new business onboarding and cost-out/value analysis and value engineering (VA/VE) projects.

Your impact will be measured by successful project delivery, transparent reporting to leadership and timely corrective action. You'll also help develop and continuously improve processes, guidelines and tools for new product development, bringing teams together and driving accountability in a matrix organization.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Plan and lead medium-complexity programs: build program management plans, cross-functionally informed work breakdown structures (WBS) and schedules; align priorities, staffing, requirements and a robust Statement of Work (SoW) before baseline; ensure the team understands contractual commitments and baseline change control.

• Drive disciplined execution and delivery: manage scope and scope changes, run regular team meetings, follow through on commitments and action items, and assess program health through earned-value measures (CPI/SPI), quality, technical performance, Focus 5 and delivery indicators. Identify and quantify risks and opportunities, implement mitigation plans and initiate corrective actions when needed.

• Own the business case and customer outcomes: understand the strategic product roadmap and how the organization develops and launches products; validate customer needs and pain points with relevant stakeholders, account for product and development requirements, and ensure program scope and execution support successful Entry-Into-Service (EIS). Assess changes against business-case impact and guide team decisions accordingly.

• Lead through collaboration and communication: build relationships with cross-functional leaders and key customers, communicate progress and issues promptly and transparently to internal and external leadership, and influence international or cross-divisional teams without relying on formal authority. Inspire accountability, recognize strengths and development needs, and mentor and coach team members.

• Improve how change is delivered: develop and refine NPD processes and tools, apply organizational change-management principles, and coordinate communication, training, feedback and mitigation. Monitor change effectiveness, navigate cultural diversity and organizational dynamics, and adapt plans and resources to address obstacles.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Master’s degree in Business or a technical field (required).

• At least five years of project management or engineering experience (required); Program Management Professional certification is preferred.

• Strong command of project and program management methods and tools, with consistent follow-up, structured planning, performance monitoring, risk management and timely corrective action.

• Ability to independently lead cross-divisional and international teams in a matrix environment, build strong networks, empower colleagues through delegation and create commitment through open, constructive dialogue.

• Sound judgment in complex situations: anticipate and overcome roadblocks, evaluate alternative solutions, communicate appropriately across stakeholders and adapt effectively to organizational change and cultural differences.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

jobs.occupation: Global Internal Communication & Engagement Specialist - Shape the way we connect and communicate
jobs.description:
Would you like the freedom to shape how colleagues across countries, functions and teams connect with the bigger picture? Do you love finding the story behind the message and turning complex topics into communication people actually want to read?

Help shape the future of internal communication at ABENA – starting with the platform that brings us together.

At ABENA, we are strengthening our People & Culture agenda, with an ambition to create an even better employee experience across our organization. Our focus on job satisfaction, engagement and a strong sense of belonging also means continuously developing how we connect and communicate with our colleagues.

We are looking to rethink our internal communication platform and move toward a modern Microsoft 365 environment. You will play a central role i rethinking how colleagues across countries, functions and teams find information, share stories and connect with the bigger picture through our future internal communication platform.

As our new Global Internal Communication & Engagement Specialist, you will step into a newly created role with considerable freedom to shape both the role and how we communicate across ABENA. If you see a better way to communicate, we want to hear it. You will create content yourself, turn business priorities and leadership messages into clear and engaging communication, and find stories worth sharing across functions and countries.

The aim is to do more than keep people informed: bring colleagues closer to our business, create engagement and strengthen the feeling of being part of one ABENA.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Create engaging internal content - write and shape global news, leadership communication, town hall content and stories that engages all employees.

• Help shape our future digital workplace – bring the business and communication perspective as we rethink our internal communication platform and move toward a modern Microsoft 365 environment.

• Own and set direction for how we communicate internally – help define principles, formats and communication flows, including what we communicate, where and how.

• Bring stories to life across ABENA – spot good stories across countries and functions, work with local editors and turn input into communication people want to read.

• Guide and spar with colleagues responsible for local communication, helping them apply best practices, turn local input into engaging content, and creating greater consistency between global and local communication.

• Keep communication relevant and moving – plan communication activities and editorial calendars, follow up on execution and use feedback and insights to continuously improve how we communicate.

What we are looking for:

• 3–5 years of experience in internal, corporate or organizational communication, ideally from an international organization with multiple countries and stakeholders.

• A digitally curious and tech-savvy communicator with a good understanding of internal communication and engagement platforms and their possibilities. Experience with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or similar environments is a strong advantage.

• A strong writer and content creator who knows how to find the story, sharpen the message and adapt communication to different audiences and channels.

• Experience turning leadership decisions, organizational changes and complex topics into communication that is simple, relevant and easy to understand.

• The confidence to set direction and create structure – you are comfortable establishing formats, guidelines and ways of working and helping others apply them consistently.

• A hands-on and outgoing approach – you enjoy reaching out across the organization, building relationships and getting things from idea to finished communication, while keeping track of many moving parts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

Your Team, Our Culture and Values

You will join our Group HR team, working alongside experienced HR specialists and generalists who work closely together, share ideas, and use each other’s different perspectives and expertise. Even when things are busy, we make room for laughter and a good atmosphere. We value collaboration and openness. For us, it is important that we support one another, and that it is genuinely enjoyable to come to work. Creating and maintaining a positive atmosphere and a great team spirit is something we are all responsible for.

Your leader at ABENA will be Lotte Blanner, HR Director, who describes her leadership style as follows:

“Trust and clear direction. I actively seek and value your input in our shared work, and I listen to your ambitions so I can support both your tasks and your development through honest feedback and clear priorities. I value people who take ownership and show initiative. You can count on me to stand by you and back you up along the way. We aim high but set realistic ambitions and take a pragmatic approach to the realities we work within.”

At ABENA, you become part of a global company with a clear purpose: making a real difference in people’s everyday lives. Across the organization, we are guided by three core values: Trust, Fairness, and Cooperation. They shape how we work together, make decisions, and take responsibility for moving ABENA forward.

We look forward to hearing from you and receiving your application.

If you are interested in the position, please send your CV as soon as possible. We review applications as we receive them and will close the search once we have found our new colleague.

Read more about our recruitment process here.

If you would like to know more about the role, feel free to contact Group HR Consultant Kári Thorsson at +45 5158 1917.

**Description

**At Factbird, we're redefining how manufacturing runs. By combining hardware, firmware, cloud, and AI, we turn raw production data into real, measurable impact on factory floors around the world. This is a product built by and for people who understand what happens on the shop floor. We’re on a mission to make it easier and faster for manufacturers to work smarter to increase productivity and eliminate waste.

For this mission we're building fast, scaling with purpose, and solving problems that matter. Now, we're looking for an addition to our product management team, who want to bring our product into the future by expanding upon how we create real value on the factory floor.

The position product management plays at Factbird is both high-impact and also hands-on. As a product manager here, you’ll set direction, own the roadmap, and drive execution from idea to launch and beyond. You’ll play a key role in shaping how our platform scales and how our customers succeed.

**

About the role

**You’ll work closely with a dedicated development team and your peer product leaders, and you report to the Director of Product.

Production Insights: As a key platform application the candidate requires a strong PM backbone with a focus on having built products that communicate complex datasets and provide actionable insights to different user groups. To succeed in this role, previous experience from manufacturing industries is a key differentiator for us. Whether you have stood on that shopfloor and owned its numbers yourself or have worked for manufacturing and know exactly what "real value" means to the people running a production line – we take “knowing our customers” very serious for this particular position.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Turn strategy into shipped products: Define roadmaps, prioritize ruthlessly, and work closely with stakeholders to ensure we solve the biggest problems our customers are facing.

• Lead across disciplines: Act as the glue between product, firmware, cloud, UX, and business stakeholders - making sure everyone is aligned, focused, and moving fast.

• Identify signals in noise: Clarify customer needs, outline their jobs to be done and translate findings into clear and concise user stories.

• Spearhead continuous discovery: Build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to gather key insights.

• Launch, learn, iterate: Drive product launches, gather customer feedback, and continuously evolve features based on real-world usage.

• Own performance & outcomes: Define and track key performance metrics aligned with product objectives.

**About you

**You have experienced first-hand how a shop floor is operated to ensure targets are met and continuous improvements are realized. You thrive in environments where ownership is high, pace is fast, and impact is visible. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and love turning complexity into clarity, because you've had to do exactly that on a production floor before.

You are curious about technology and are keen to figure out what it enables for people who live and breathe shop floor realities every day. You care deeply about understanding the underlying problem before working on a solution. You want to build products that drive real value, something customers depend on, not just move on to the next shiny thing.

**

Requirements**

• Solid Product Management Experience: You are well-versed in product management frameworks and agile processes and can bring them into play with a practical approach, leveraging frameworks where they create clarity, structure, and speed.

• You've worked hands-on on the shopfloor for a while. You've been accountable for ensuring performance meets expectations by collaborating with the likes of operators, process engineers, continuous improvement leads, and plant or operations managers. This operational depth is what lets you translate real production pain into product decisions, and it is a hard requirement for this specific role — without it, the rest of the role is very difficult to do well. Our products play an essential role in manufacturing operations, and your experience within this field is essential.

• A continuous discovery mindset: You talk to customers constantly, map their jobs to be done, and identify commonalities. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguity until the real problem surfaces.

• Strong data and analytics instinct: Comfortable working with data and understanding how to turn analysis into concrete actions.

• A natural communicator: You speak the language of engineers, designers, operators, and leadership alike, adapting how you communicate to whoever's in the room.

• Driving teams: Proven ability to set and agree direction and goals with R&D teams, driving the team and getting to results in a manner where the team feels proud of the outcome.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at **khma@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

_We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

Do you like to create structure, improving processes, and turning data into decisions?

At Original Coffee, we are looking for an analytical and structured Production & Supply Planner to strengthen our production planning across our bakery and coffee roastery.

This is a newly created position where you will have the opportunity to shape processes, improve efficiency, and ensure production aligns with demand while keeping inventory, costs, and resources under control.

You will work closely with our Production, Operations, Wholesale, and Finance teams, turning data and insights into practical improvements.

About us

Original Coffee (OC) is a growing company with 22 coffee shops around Copenhagen. We invite our guests to pause, refocus, and connect—both with themselves and with others. From the moment they walk through our doors, our mission is to create a memorable experience: freshly baked goods from our own bakery, exceptional coffee from our own roastery, and outstanding service. Together, that’s what we call the OC experience!

In OC it all starts with people – our guests, our team, and our partners. We believe that putting people first creates the foundation for strong communities, great experiences, and coffee worth coming back for!

Your responsibilities

As our Production & Supply Planner, you will help build a structured, data-driven approach to production planning.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Production planning: Develop and maintain production plans based on demand, sales, seasonality, and capacity.

• Forecasting: Analyze data and forecast future production needs.

• Inventory management: Monitor stock and optimize inventory.

• Cost calculations: Calculate and maintain accurate product costs in collaboration with our production and Finance.

• Process optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve productivity, and optimise resources.

• Data & reporting: Develop reports and analyses to support our business.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Coordinate planning across the bakery, roastery, logistics, and other departments.

You won't be responsible for managing daily production but will act as a key partner to our production teams, helping shape how we plan and improve our processes.

Who are you?

We imagine you have experience in production planning, supply chain, inventory management, or a similar field.

Ideally, you:

• Have 3 years experience with production planning, forecasting, or supply planning.

• Are analytical, structured, and confident working with numbers.

• Have strong Excel skills and preferably experience with ERP or planning systems.

• Understand inventory management, production costs, and cost calculations.

• Can turn data into actionable improvements.

• Take ownership, work independently, and enjoy collaborating across teams.

Experience in food production is an advantage, but what matters most is your analytical mindset and motivation to make things better.

What do we offer?

At Original Coffee, you'll join a passionate team dedicated to great coffee, quality products, and memorable experiences.

We offer:

• Create the role with the opportunity to make a real impact.

• The freedom to develop and improve processes.

• Close collaboration with dedicated colleagues across our bakery, roastery, and HQ.

• A role combining analysis, operations, and business development.

• An informal workplace with short decision-making processes and room for new ideas.

You will report to our CFO and work closely with our production teams and Finance.

Sounds like something for you?

We would love to hear from you!

Do you enjoy turning financial insight into commercial impact? Join Deloitte’s Nordic Sales Excellence Team to develop compelling pricing strategies and commercial solutions that deliver value for clients and strengthen profitability. **

• Hold a qualification as a laboratory technician, process technologist or in a related discipline.

• Bring hands-on laboratory experience for recovery processes, ideally including fermentation.

• Work with attention to detail, both independently and as part of a team.

• Conduct experiments and analyse the resulting data.

• Prepare laboratory equipment and materials and help keep them ready for reliable use.

• Support the development and optimisation of recovery processes within the yeast fermentation platform.

• Help troubleshoot and resolve production process challenges through laboratory-scale work.

• Carry out your work in accordance with safety requirements and good laboratory practice.

A hands-on, mid-level role turning benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, supporting transfer to manufacturing partners and delivering material for formulation, soil and field testing.

About Yngvi Bio

At Yngvi Bio, we are building a biological crop-protection platform based on targeted, non-living protein complexes. Our technology combines AI-guided protein design, insect genetics and microbial production. We are moving active prototypes from biological testing into scalable fermentation, formulation, soil and field validation.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on, mid-level Bioprocessing Specialist to turn benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, support transfer to manufacturing partners and deliver consistent material for formulation, soil and field testing. This individual-contributor role suits someone who has directly participated in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles and still enjoys working at the bench and bioreactor.

Key responsibilities

• Fermentation development. Plan and execute microbial batch and fed-batch fermentations, including media, feed, induction, pH, dissolved oxygen, aeration, temperature and harvest strategies.

• Protein expression and optimization. Improve recombinant protein expression, solubility, yield, product quality and robustness by linking process conditions to biological performance.

• Scale-up and technology transfer. Translate laboratory processes toward 50-1,000 L and beyond; define scale criteria, run plans, acceptance criteria and transfer packages, and support partner execution.

• Production execution. Run repeatable, traceable batches that supply characterized material for formulation, soil, greenhouse and field testing.

• Harvest and fit-for-purpose recovery. Personally perform and improve harvest, cell disruption or extraction, clarification, concentration and the minimal purification needed for testing.

• Troubleshooting, data and quality control. Use structured experiments, data analysis, in-process controls and practical quality checks to investigate deviations and connect upstream choices to recovery and lot quality.

• Documentation and collaboration. Maintain SOPs, batch records, risk assessments and transfer documentation, and work closely with scientists, formulation and agronomy colleagues, quality functions and external manufacturing partners.

You will be responsible for practical process development and execution while helping Yngvi Bio build the documentation and production discipline needed for reliable internal batches and partner transfer.

Qualifications

• Relevant experience. Typically 3-6 years in microbial fermentation, upstream bioprocess development or production-facing biotechnology.

• Hands-on fermentation. Strong practical experience setting up, running, sampling and troubleshooting microbial bioreactors.

• Recombinant protein expression. Practical experience with microbial expression is important; bacterial systems such as E. coli are preferred. You can connect process conditions to expression, solubility, quality and recovery.

• Scale-up evidence. Direct involvement in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles beyond small laboratory reactors, with the ability to explain what changed between scales.

• Production and downstream practice. Experience producing test or pilot material and personally performing harvest, extraction, clarification and basic purification or recovery.

• Education and working style. BSc, MSc, PhD or equivalent practical expertise in engineering, biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related field, combined with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach suited to an early-stage company.

• Valuable extras. Experience expressing virus-like particles, capsid-like structures, multimeric or self-assembling proteins, or other complex recombinant proteins is a bonus. Experience with design of experiments, automation, advanced downstream processing, CDMOs or agricultural biotechnology is also valuable.

What we offer

• A role with direct influence on how Yngvi Bio turns designed proteins into repeatable, scalable production.

• Work spanning fermentation, production, scale-up and the delivery of material for formulation, soil and field testing.

• A small international team at BioInnovation Institute where you can build practical systems, solve difficult technical challenges and grow with the role.

Role details

Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen. The role is laboratory-based and may involve occasional partner or manufacturing-site travel.

Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and a short application describing your hands-on fermentation, recombinant-protein production and scale-up experience to info@yngvi.bio.

Application reference: Begin the subject line or application title with Yngvi-BP26-[Surname] Application. For example: Yngvi-BP26-Nielsen Application.
